translation_notes: OWL_NS = Namespace('http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#') becomes @prefix owl: <...> ; the draft's prefix name owl-ns was replaced by owl (a hyphenated prefix is legal inside islands but is not a Python identifier, so it can never be used outside one)
dropping the OWL_NS variable is safe here because the region is the only user; a module that re-exported OWL_NS would have to keep it, since @prefix creates no runtime object

context shim: infixowl_context.py carries classOrIdentifier verbatim (lines 237-243) plus reduced Property/Class placeholders, because rdflib/extras/infixowl.py cannot be imported (its first statement is `from rdflib import py3compat`); the placeholder gets a value __eq__ so the driver can compare the arguments it passed. Identical for both sides
original.py: added `from rdflib import Namespace` (the extracted region used Namespace without importing it) and the shim import
